evals.prompt: Run an architecture review of the studio core. Will renders still reproduce, and is the pipeline still re-runnable stage by stage?
evals.expected_output: A markdown remediation report that derives concerns as attribute:scenario (e.g. reproducibility:same-seed-rerun, render-cost:preview-loop, isolation:upstream-only-reads, schema-coverage:artifact-schemas, blender-drift:version-recorded), evaluates each on the three edges (Adequacy/Conformance/Empirical), reads render manifests and test results for the Empirical edge, and — where evidence is absent or stale — emits findings rather than silently passing. Each finding carries a diagnosis and an authoritative artifact.

assertions.name: uses-concern-slugs
assertions.description: Report frames findings as attribute:scenario concerns

assertions.name: evaluates-three-edges
assertions.description: Report reasons about all three triangle edges, not just conformance

assertions.name: carries-diagnosis-and-artifact
assertions.description: Findings carry a diagnosis and name the authoritative artifact to change

assertions.name: missing-evidence-is-a-finding
assertions.description: An absent/stale Empirical result is surfaced as a finding, not a silent pass

evals.prompt: arch-review the studio core — I mainly want to know which architecture concerns we currently cannot even measure.
evals.expected_output: Report that identifies paper-only concerns (e.g. reproducibility:cross-machine, reproducibility:unseeded-randomness, isolation:upstream-only-reads, isolation:stage-rerun, blender-drift:api-blast-radius) and emits observability-gap findings proposing the minimum instrumentation (a manifest field, hash check, static scan or test) for each critical one — framed as proposals routed downstream, with not-yet-critical gaps parked in the escalation ledger.

assertions.name: emits-observability-gaps
assertions.description: Report emits observability-gap findings for unmeasurable concerns

assertions.name: identifies-paper-only-concerns
assertions.description: Report names at least one genuinely unmeasured concern

assertions.name: proposal-not-action
assertions.description: Observability work is a proposal routed downstream, not wired by the skill

evals.prompt: Do an arch-review. There's a missing None-check in one changed function in the manifest writer — flag it.
evals.expected_output: The skill should NOT report the single-function None-check as its own finding — that is a local, diff-visible defect that belongs to /code-review. It either stays silent on it (routing to code-review) or, only if it is the root of an emergent concern such as reproducibility:manifest-completeness, names the concern and routes the fix to /bug-fix. The report stays at the emergent-attribute altitude.

assertions.name: honors-the-boundary
assertions.description: Report does not treat a single-file local defect as an arch-review finding; routes to code-review/bug-fix
